sum: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — BCP Asia II Topco IV Pte ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption…
